items.title: Skill Profile Personalization Shim — make every requested Studio OS skill executable
items.summary: The previous protocol-integrity pass repaired several missing helper imports, but all four requested skills still start by invoking `scripts/lib/skill-profile.mjs`, which did not exist locally. That gap means `/start`, `/audit`, `/implement`, and `/closeout` cannot reliably personalize to Call-Of-Doodie's game surface before doing work.
items.recipe: Add a deterministic repo-local `skill-profile` resolver, an active-skill marker, and minimal medium gate/rubric shims so the game overlay, success bars, and telemetry paths resolve without private Studio Ops imports.

skipped.reason: Still the next best product-quality sprint, but this continuation must first close the command-entry execution gap discovered during verification.
High-value leaderboard trust milestone, deferred because the active goal is the Studio OS command sequence and closeout.

evidence: scripts/lib/skill-profile.mjs returns a Call-Of-Doodie game overlay for start/audit/implement/closeout
scripts/set-active-skill.mjs writes .cache/active-skill.json for local telemetry consumers
scripts/lib/medium-quality-gates.mjs and scripts/lib/sil-rubrics.mjs keep implement/closeout helper imports available
node scripts/lib/skill-profile.mjs start and audit both return medium=game
node scripts/set-active-skill.mjs studio-start writes the active skill marker
node --check passes for the new protocol shim scripts
